component.name: AudioForge
component.summary: Remove background noise and polish your voice

description.p: AudioForge sits between your microphone and the apps you talk in. It cuts background noise, evens out your level, tames harsh "s" sounds and sudden peaks, and lets you shape your tone. A guided setup tests its suggestions on your own recording before you apply them.
On Linux it adds an "AudioForge Mic" input to PipeWire, so Discord, OBS and browsers can record the processed voice directly. Everything runs on your computer, with no account and no cloud service.
